mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment consistently compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers central bank policy accommodation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in late-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in tightening cycles is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS) consistently signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in tightening cycles is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production (INDPRO) consistently signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
